title: Trims that sell differently are priced on their own
lines: Ask about a Firebird Trans Am, a GTA or a Turbo Trans Am and the range comes from that trim's own sales. The same goes for the Camaro Z28 and IROC-Z, and the Mustang LX, GT, Cobra and Saleen. Replicas and tributes are set aside and counted.
